title: Lakers release injury report for Wednesday's game versus Bucks
text:
Lakers release injury report for Wednesday's game versus Bucks Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter Shop LAKERS Lakers release injury report for Wednesday's game versus Bucks
 Robert Marvi Lakers Wire Nov. 10, 2026, 8:42 p.m. PT The Los Angeles Lakers have been on a somewhat unexpected roll lately. They have a 10-2 record and a six-game winning streak, and they will continue their four-game road trip by facing the rebuilding Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday.
 It is a brave new world for the Bucks, who traded franchise player Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Miami Heat over the summer. At 1-10, they have the worst record in the Eastern Conference, and they're bound for a long and difficult rebuilding process.
 The Lakers were without Austin Reaves when they defeated the Atlanta Hawks 124-114 on Monday , as he was dealing with an illness. He is off the injury report for Wednesday's matchup, but guard Quentin Grimes, who also didn't play on Monday, remains on the report. He's listed as questionable with a right finger sprain.
 With Reaves and Grimes out of action, and with Luka Doncic scoring a mere 32 points, L.A. got 21 points from Walker Kessler, 23 points from Sandro Mamukelashvili and 18 points from Collin Sexton. Its bench scored a robust 49 points overall, and perhaps this is a model for the team to follow in terms of achieving better scoring balance moving forward.
 It will wrap up this road trip by facing the Phoenix Suns on Sunday before returning home to host the Charlotte Hornets next Tuesday, Nov. 17.
